workflow: Cucumbers exposed to artificial light during their growing period can significantly increase in weight as compared to cucumbers that are not exposed to light. This is due to the accelerated growth time provided by the lighting. As a result, farmers gain the capability to produce large amounts of cucumbers quickly and on demand.
